lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 오늘 계속 하품을 하네요. 피곤해요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, you keep yawning today. Are you tired?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, oneul gyesok hapumeul haneyo. Pigonhaeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 요즘 잠을 못 자기 때문에 하품이 나요.
lines.en: Yes, I yawn because I can't sleep these days.
lines.roman: Ne, yojeum jameul mot jagi ttaemune hapumi nayo.

lines.beaver_en: What happened to your hand? The back of it is red.
lines.learner: 넘어졌기 때문에 손등이 빨개요. 손목도 아파요.
lines.en: It's red because I fell. My wrist hurts too.
lines.roman: Neomeojyeotgi ttaemune sondeungi ppalgaeyo. Sonmokdo apayo.

lines.beaver_en: Your wrist too? Does it hurt a lot?
lines.learner: 네, 손목이 아프기 때문에 타자도 못 쳐요.
lines.en: Yes, I can't even type because my wrist hurts.
lines.roman: Ne, sonmogi apeugi ttaemune tajado mot chyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Walking looks uncomfortable for you, too.
lines.learner: 왼발도 조금 다쳤어요. 그래서 천천히 걸어요.
lines.en: I hurt my left foot a bit too. So I walk slowly.
lines.roman: Oenbaldo jogeum dachyeosseoyo. Geuraeseo cheoncheonhi georeoyo.

lines.learner: 요즘 손발이 자주 차가워요. 감각도 좀 이상해요.
lines.en: My hands and feet are often cold. The feeling is odd too.
lines.roman: Yojeum sonbari jaju chagawoyo. Gamgakdo jom isanghaeyo.

lines.en: Sometimes I have no feeling in my fingertips.

lines.beaver_en: Have you been to the hospital?
lines.learner: 네, 의사가 간이 좀 안 좋다고 했어요.
lines.en: Yes, the doctor said my liver isn't very good.
lines.roman: Ne, uisaga gani jom an jotago haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Your liver? Did you drink a lot?
lines.learner: 네, 회식이 많았기 때문에 술을 자주 마셨어요.
lines.en: Yes, I drank often because there were many team dinners.
lines.roman: Ne, hoesigi manatgi ttaemune sureul jaju masyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Cut down on drinking now and rest well.
lines.learner: 네, 건강이 중요하기 때문에 술을 끊을 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll quit drinking because health is important.
lines.roman: Ne, geongangi jungyohagi ttaemune sureul kkeuneul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Go home early today. I'll help you.
lines.learner: 지영 씨, 고마워요. 내일 커피 살게요.
lines.en: Thanks, Jiyeong. I'll buy you coffee tomorrow.
lines.roman: Jiyeong ssi, gomawoyo. Naeil keopi salgeyo.
